Fei worked in the Oldham lab from October 2023 to February 2026. He studied the
metabolic pathways that contribute to myofibroblast differentiation and
extracellular matrix production in experimental models of pulmonary fibrosis,
and showed that TGF-β coordinates alanine synthesis and import to support
myofibroblast differentiation.
